name: Kami-sama no Kakera
source:
A young man, Orimoto, who attends a university in Tokyo, met a girl who is a god enshrined in a company in a forest near her parents' house a few years ago. I was going to see you.
When returning to Tokyo, it was an analysis book that was separated every year saying "I will come to see you again next year", but this year, I will visit her again only two months later.
While it was raining cold, Zhenmoto recalled the time spent with her...
